classification.difficultyReason: Form a perimeter equation containing fractional multiples of the unknown, solve it exactly and substitute to find four lengths.

content.prompt: The perimeter of this quadrilateral is 100 cm. Find the value of $x$ and the lengths of the four sides.

spec.sourceRegion: Review question 12, quadrilateral below the stem
spec.description: Unshaded irregular quadrilateral retaining the short left edge, rising upper edge, descending right edge and long lower edge. Decorative blue source outlines are rendered black under house style. Coordinates describe appearance only and supply no numerical measurements.
spec.mathematics: Left side x/7 cm; upper side 4x/7 cm; right side 2x/3 cm; lower side x cm. No additional geometric marks.
spec.answerVisibility: All four algebraic side labels are permanent givens; no numerical answers appear.

answer.short:
$x=42$. The sides are $6\text{ cm}$ (left), $24\text{ cm}$ (upper), $28\text{ cm}$ (right) and $42\text{ cm}$ (lower).

Add the four side expressions and equate their sum to 100.
answer.worked:
The perimeter is the sum of the four side lengths. Multiply the equation by 21 to clear the denominators.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{7}+\frac{4x}{7}+\frac{2x}{3}+x&=100\\3x+12x+14x+21x&=2100\\50x&=2100\\x&=42\end{align*}$$

Substitute $x=42$ into each side expression:

$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{7}&=\frac{42}{7}=6\text{ cm}\\\frac{4x}{7}&=\frac{4\times42}{7}=24\text{ cm}\\\frac{2x}{3}&=\frac{2\times42}{3}=28\text{ cm}\\x&=42\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

Check: $6+24+28+42=100\text{ cm}$.
